_doc: L07 CYCLOPS: the Cyclops controller and its child kinds (ENG3.DLL static RE via ghidra-mcp; nothing renamed). RVAs without base 0x10000000 unless written in full. Frame numbers are anim-script values (obj+0x34); the PNGs in extracted/sprites use the same numbers (fNNNN), and the impact frames line up within one frame (off-by-one is a LEAD). Durations: a script entry {frame, t} shows for t+1 ticks (GFX_AnimStepActor 0x1dbc0). Trigger columns were decoded from the MAP_PSX.BIN zone table (0x4067c) and attr records (0x40668) with the LVL_CellAttribute 0x1b4a0 rule. Column c covers track x c*128+64 .. c*128+191. Rows 3-8 are the whole street width.

0x0029.what: the Cyclops: a background giant kept 1664 units ahead of the hero and locked to the camera. It stomps (camera shake, and the stomp arms the toppling columns), throws one rock per throw trigger and plays idle actions. It cannot be hit and never touches the hero
0x0029.evidence: VERIFIED-STATIC (behaviour); VISUAL (frames: CYCLOPS bank 5, CYEND bank 7)
0x0029.creation: Call chain: LVL_StartSection -> 0x1b9c0 -> 0x1870 (gs+0 == 8) -> 0x3290. 0x3290 calls LVL_NewActor(0xa20000, 0x1c60000, 0, 0x3c) [skyline], then LVL_NewActor(0xa20000, 0x1c60000, 0, 0x29), which goes to DAT 0x3fb0c. It then sets x = hero x + 0x6800000 (1664), track +0x38 = hero track, state +0x2a = 0x42, script 4. This is not a map spawn (the L07 map has no 0x29). The Cyclops is created again at every section start and restart.
0x0029.spawn_0x3200: +0x98 = 0x50, +0xcc = 0x50 (shake counter), flags +0x50 = 0x202, +0x54 = 0x80000000, draw type +0x23 = 6, +0x3e = 0x7fa, +0xd8 = 1 (stomp foot toggle), +0xac = 1 (throw armed), +0x11e = 0, 0x1e280 reset, frame 0x2c, script 0
0x0029.movement: Every tick: x += (0x3fb94 - 0x3fb98) << 16, i.e. the camera x delta. 0x3fb94 is camera x 0x405e0 and 0x3fb98 the previous value; both are set in LVL_UpdateObjects. A delta < -0x180 counts as 0. If x > 0x7f7fffff: x = 0 and track = hero track + 1 (it follows the track chain). y 0x1c60000 (454) and z 0 are fixed. No spline is used: 0x3610 does not call LVL_TrackSpline.
0x0029.bank: +0x22 = 7 (CYEND) while the script pointer is 0x33100 (script 1) or 0x331b0 (script 3), else 5 (CYCLOPS). Script list 0x33800 (anim entry 0x338b8 + 0x29*16).
0x0029.damage: None directly: 0x3610 never calls HERO_Hit and the Cyclops has no hit box. Damage comes from its thrown rock (kind 0x30, hit code 2 -> T3 = 25/30/40) and from the columns 0x2b/0x2e it arms (hit code 2 -> 25/30/40). It cannot catch the hero and causes no instant death.
0x0029.difficulty: none (gs+0xe is not read by 0x1870/0x3200/0x3290/0x3610/0x3340/0x33f0; difficulty acts only through the HERO_ApplyDamage table 0x380a0)
0x0029.random: None in the controller. The idle action is chosen by a deterministic counter, DAT 0x3f218: 0 -> script 3, 1 -> script 6, 2 -> script 7, then it wraps. Its initial value is 0 and it is only written in 0x3610, so a restart does not reset it.
0x0029.triggers: HERO_SurfaceTriggers 0x17ae0 is called every tick from HERO_PreStep with LVL_TriggerAt at the hero position. 0x53 -> state 0x42. 0x54 -> state 0x44 + script 5. 0x57 -> state 0x41 + script 0 (+0xd8 == 0) or script 2 (+0xd8 == 1). 0x5b -> state 0x43 + script 8. Because the call repeats every tick, the script restarts each tick while the hero stands in the trigger column. The Cyclops holds the first frame, and the move plays out after the hero leaves the column.

0x0030.what: rock thrown by the Cyclops (model 0x21 = 33, one of the 0x2a rubble models; model shadow 0x2002). It flies back toward the hero down lane z 64
0x0030.spawn: From 0x3610 state 0x43 at frame 0xa1 while +0xac != 0: LVL_NewActor(cx, cy - 0x1800000, cz + 0x800000, 0x30). The rock is kept in Cyclops +0x118, the track is copied and +0xac = 0 (one rock per throw).
0x0030.motion: Each tick x -= +0xd8 (0x200000 = 32/tick toward the hero). Spin +0xdc = 0x10 on the angles. Gravity +0xc0 = 0xf000 via LVL_ObjFallStep. z is forced to 0x400000 (64) every tick. On the first tick it aims (+0x98 = 0x1050 heading to the hero, state 8 -> 2). On a bounce the speed >>= 3. On the first bounce (+0x30 == 1): SFX 0xe206 and 4 shards 0x4002 (quarter mirror flags +0x94/+0x96). Freed by LVL_IsOffscreen(0x100).
0x0030.damage: Within dx < 0x578 (1400), a box -0x80 < dx < 0x80 and -0x36 < dz < 0x36 sets hero +0x116 = 2 and hero +0x110 = rock, then calls HERO_Hit 0x19200 unless the hero is in state 5. Code 2 = T3: 25 / 30 / 40 (Beginner / Medium / Herculean); knock-back x -1.0, z 3.0 away.

0x003c.what: distant city skyline backdrop (PEOPLE frame 240, 256x32, palette 15) kept 1664 ahead of the hero and locked to the camera like the Cyclops
0x003c.notes: Created by 0x3290 before the Cyclops (not a map spawn). Spawn: flags 0x202, +0x23 = 6, +0x3e = 0x7da, LVL_AttachPickup(0x2002), x = hero x + 0x6800000. Tick: x += camera delta (a delta < -0x80 counts as 0); when x > 0x7f7fffff, x = 0 on the next track; frame forced to 0xf0 (240). At runtime this kind drew 1 PEOPLE frame.

0x4002.what: debris shard marker. On CYCLOPS it is a tumbling stone chunk (PEOPLE 284-290, script 0x37658, 1 tick per frame, loop): the 4 pieces of the Cyclops's thrown rock
0x4002.notes: Spawned by 0x33f0 (4 per rock, mirror flags per quarter). Init on level 8: bank 6 + script 0x37658 (GAUNTLET/TORMENT: frame 4 and flags |= 0x10000040). Random speeds +0xb8/+0xbc = 0x200000 + rand(0x200000), +0xc0 = 0x10000 + rand(0x10000), lifetime +0x3a = 600 - rand(400). Tick on level 8: bounce step 0x1460 (ground y 0x1c00000, or 0x1400000 on track 0 for x in 0x37000000..0x41000000) plus anim. Freed (0x1d190) when x < hero x - 128, or on a bounce with +0xe0 != 0. No hero test.

0x4003.what: stone chunk debris (same PEOPLE 284-290 script 0x37658) for CYCLOPS boulders 0x2a and columns 0x2b/0x2e
0x4003.notes: Init is the same as the level-8 path of 0x4002 (bank 6, script 0x37658, random speeds and lifetime). Tick: bounce step 0x1460 plus anim; freed when x < hero x - 32. Spawned 8 per boulder (0x2a) and 6 per column piece (0x2b/0x2e: launch RT_RandMod_slot(0x300000) + 0x300000, 4-way mirror flags). No hero test.

0x0038.what: placeholder spawned by state 0x44. All three handlers are RT_StubVoid 0x2390 and there is no anim entry, so nothing is visible
0x0038.notes: 0x3610 state 0x44, frame 0x20: once (DAT 0x3fb14 == 0), LVL_NewActor(cx + 0x1000000, cy, cz - 0x400000, 0x38). State 0x44 is entered only by trigger 0x54, and no CYCLOPS map cell carries 0x54 (attr record 8 = 0x54 is unused). Its script 5 frames 14-43 are empty in the decoded CYCLOPS bank. This is dead or unfinished content.

states.name: idle / action cycle
states.entered_by: creation (0x3290), trigger 0x53, end of throw (0x43 frame 0xa7, with script 1), end of 0x44 (frame 0x2b)
states.bank_frames: script 4: CYCLOPS 2-12, 3 ticks each (33-tick loop); action scripts below
states.transitions: At frame 0xc (end of script 4), counter 0x3f218 picks one of three scripts. Script 3: CYEND 16-33, club smash with falling rubble drawn in the frames, SFX 0x20b/0x200/0x202/0x201/0x203, ~72 ticks. Script 6: CYCLOPS 134-148, club shake/roar, ~60 ticks; CALL 3 = 0x6f70 plays roar SFX 0x211/0x212/0x22c/0x22d in turn. Script 7: CYCLOPS 96-114, crouch-and-flex roar with CALL 3, ~76 ticks. +0x98 += 1. Frames 0xf, 0x21, 0x94, 0x72, 0x2b, 0x4d, 0xa7 and 0x36 (the last frame of each script) -> script 4. The actions spawn nothing.

states.name: stomp
states.bank_frames: +0xd8 == 0: script 0, CYCLOPS 44-58 (3 ticks each; SFX 0x20e at 48, 0x208 at 55). +0xd8 == 1: script 2, CYCLOPS 83-95 (SFX 0x20d at 87, 0x209 at 92). The frames show a sumo leg lift and stamp.
states.telegraph: leg lift: ~30 ticks (script 0, frames 44-53) or ~29 ticks (script 2, frames 83-90) after the hero leaves the 0x57 column
states.impact: Frame 0x36 (54) or 0x5b (91): +0x11e = 1. This starts the camera shake, and every live column 0x2b/0x2e latches its fall (+0x30 = 1).

states.name: stomp recovery
states.bank_frames: Script 1: CYEND 1-15 (Cyclops upright, club raised; SFX 0x20c), ~49 ticks to frame 15. Then script 4 (idle) runs while the state stays 0x45.
states.transitions: Same frame rules as 0x42 (the idle actions run), but +0x11e stays 2, so the shake runs its full 80 ticks. Trigger 0x53 -> 0x42.

states.name: rock throw
states.bank_frames: script 8: CYCLOPS 149-172, 3 ticks each (149-153 picks up a rock, 155-157 winds back, 159-160 throws; SFX 0x20a after 160)
states.telegraph: wind-up frames 149-160: 12 frames x 3 = 36 ticks after the hero leaves the 0x5b column
states.transitions: frame 0xa7 (167): script 1, state 0x42 (frames 167-172 are never shown; the decoded bank ends at 166)

states.name: unused (trigger 0x54 is not on the map)
states.bank_frames: script 5: CYCLOPS 14-43 (empty in the decoded bank)

states.name: hero died
states.transitions: none until the section restarts (0x3290 makes a new Cyclops)

states.name: gs+3 == 2 pose
states.entered_by: gs+3 == 2. On CYCLOPS no ENG3 code writes this: LVL_EndObjectUpdate 0x16320 writes gs+3 = 2 only for levels 2 and 10, and for level 8 it clears flag 0x37b94 without writing.

camera_shake: While +0x11e is 1 or 2 and +0xcc != 0, each tick runs three steps: 0x405fc = +0xe0, +0xe0 += 0x20000, and above 0x80000 it wraps to -0x80000 (saw-tooth -8..+8). +0xcc -= 1 per tick from 0x50 (80 ticks). Otherwise +0xcc = 0x50 and 0x405fc = 0. GFX_SetupView 0x22070 adds 0x405fc to the view.

cyend.what: CYEND (bank 7, 32 frames) is a second Cyclops sprite bank, not an end cut-scene. The controller swaps +0x22 to 7 whenever script 1 (CYEND 1-15, upright with club raised) or script 3 (CYEND 16-33, club smash with rubble) is active.
uses: script 1: stomp recovery (0x45), after a throw, hero death (0x47)
cyend.end_of_level: There is no Cyclops defeat or ending in ENG3. Completion: LVL_EndObjectUpdate 0x16320 (the end object, level 8) calls HERO_LevelComplete 0x19c20 once (flag 0x37b98) when hero x > 0x777fffff (30592). This sets hero state 9 (script 0x37ea0). Once the hero frame passes 0x1e, HERO_State09 0x19cd0 starts the fade (0x4254c = 0xf8, 0x35168 = 0x80, 0x3fa40 = 0), calls 0x1fb10(1) and sets gs+0x1b30 = 4. When the hero script ends it sets gs+3 = 0x31. None of this touches the Cyclops, which keeps its current state.

traffic.source: All cross-traffic comes from fixed map spawns: the track spawn lists (level.json tracks[].spawns, 196/177/165/0). LVL_SpawnStep 0x1c430 emits a spawn when its x enters (end column*128, end*128 + 256) of the drawn range. Each handler then activates on hero distance or on surface trigger codes. There is no global timer and no random schedule.

per_kind.0x002a falling boulder (55): drops when the hero is near (< 1024); hit 0x200
per_kind.0x002b / 0x002e toppling columns (14 / 2: Inert until a Cyclops stomp impact (+0x11e == 1) happens while they are alive (latch +0x30 = 1). They then topple when hero dx < (byte + 7) * 128. Hit 2.
per_kind.0x002d crossing chariot (7): starts when the hero is < 768; z + 8/tick; freed at wall code 0x5d; hit 0x400
per_kind.0x002f oncoming chariot (7): drives down the street toward the hero; fades once 32 behind the hero; hit 0x400
per_kind.0x003f crowd source (8): Spawns fleeing citizens 0x4033 ahead of the hero at interval +0xdc (max 32; LVL_Rand picks count/x/script). Surface codes: 0x6e (64), 0x6f (32), 0x70 (stop, free). On the map: 0x6f at track 1 column 25; 0x70 at track 0 columns 76, 245, track 1 columns 115, 125, 172, 246 and track 2 columns 62, 151, 209, 221; 0x6e is unused. Citizen hit 4.
per_kind.0x0042 bystander (15): starts running with the hero when reached; hit 4
per_kind.0x003d swooper (3) / 0x003e rock-droppin: position-triggered: the swooper circles in from 2304 ahead; the flyer drops at hero < 768 and dives at < 900

traffic.third_spline: Splines 2/5/8 are read by LVL_CycFleeingCitizenTick 0x5760 and LVL_CycBystanderTick 0x5b40 (LVL_TrackSpline(.., 0x19, x)). They are the citizens' running path, not a Cyclops path (the Cyclops uses no spline).
